index.name: SGM Studios - Suno AI Workflow Suite
index.description: Six-script pipeline for importing, organizing, and mastering Suno AI audio in REAPER. Import ZIP files, rename/categorize tracks, detect BPM, split at structural boundaries, normalize loudness, and align stems — end to end, no coding required.

reapack.name: SGM_Suno ZIP Importer.lua
reapack.desc: Import a Suno AI ZIP file: unzip, parse metadata, create color-coded session with lyrics markers

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix crash on import: reaper.GetTempPath() is not a REAPER API function + Quote every shell path (single-quote escaping) so a ZIP filename can never inject commands + Sanitise the temp folder name derived from the ZIP filename + Decode \uXXXX escapes in info.json; only accept string values + Accept .m4a/.flac/.ogg/.opus/.aif(f) audio as well as .mp3/.wav + Always clean the temp folder, including on error paths + 1.1.1: Validate every ZIP member path before extraction (zip-slip guard; fails closed); nil-guard track creation

reapack.name: Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer.lua
reapack.desc: Scan tracks, parse Suno AI filenames, rename tracks, assign colors, and tag metadata

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Strip a Suno ID that sits before the stem suffix ("Song_<id>_vocals") + Create one region per song span instead of one per stem track + Robust option parsing (empty fields no longer shift the other options) + 1.0.2: Fix stem detection when a Suno ID suffix is present + 1.0.1: Fix Suno ID detection (invalid {8,32} Lua pattern → validated %w+ match); fix stem label casing

reapack.name: Suno_02_TempoMapper.lua
reapack.desc: Analyse a selected Suno audio item, estimate BPM, and insert a REAPER tempo marker

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix peak-cache call: the API function is GetMediaItemTake_Peaks (MediaItemTake_GetPeaks does not exist) + Fix peak buffer layout (maximums block, then minimums block, interleaved per channel) + Fix peak start time: project time, not 0 (items away from 0 s analysed the wrong audio) + Mask the bit-packed return value (sample count lives in the low 20 bits) + Guard marker now restores the previous project tempo instead of repeating the new one + Use SetTempoTimeSigMarker (AddTempoTimeSigMarker is deprecated) + Robust parameter parsing + 1.0.0: Initial release

reapack.name: Suno_03_DynamicSplitter.lua
reapack.desc: Split Suno audio items at structural boundaries (verse/chorus/bridge) using energy contrast

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix peak-cache call: the API function is GetMediaItemTake_Peaks (MediaItemTake_GetPeaks does not exist) + Fix peak buffer layout, project-time start offset and bit-packed return value + Fix inverted sensitivity: lower values now split more, as documented + Robust parameter parsing + 1.0.0: Initial release

reapack.name: Suno_04_LoudnessMaster.lua
reapack.desc: Batch-normalise selected Suno items to a target dBFS RMS level with a peak ceiling

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Measure real samples via GetAudioAccessorSamples instead of guessing RMS from the peak cache + Peak-cache path kept as a fallback, with the correct API name, start time and return masking + True sample peak (max of |max| and |min|) for the ceiling check + Robust parameter parsing + 1.0.0: Initial release

reapack.name: Suno_05_StemAligner.lua
reapack.desc: Organise third-party stem separations (UVR5, Demucs, Fadr) into a mix-ready layout

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Bus is created even when folder creation is disabled + Never wrap other songs' tracks: folder creation is skipped when a group's tracks are not adjacent + Never corrupt an existing folder hierarchy + Guard against a failed CreateTrackSend + 1.0.2: Fix song-name extraction; folder/bus indices from live track numbers + 1.0.1: Fix Suno ID stripping pattern

reapack.name: SGM_SunoWorkflow_Bundle.lua
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Suno AI Workflow Suite: six-script pipeline for importing and preparing Suno AI tracks

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + 2026-11-13 audit release: fixes to every script in the suite + Fix @provides paths by declaring every provided file as a source of this package + SGM_Suno ZIP Importer 1.1.2: GetTempPath crash, shell quoting, JSON unicode + Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer 1.0.3: ID before stem, one region per song + Suno_02_TempoMapper 1.0.1: peak API, project-time peaks, meaningful guard marker + Suno_03_DynamicSplitter 1.0.1: peak API, inverted sensitivity + Suno_04_LoudnessMaster 1.0.1: real sample measurement + Suno_05_StemAligner 1.0.3: bus without folder, folder safety + 1.1.2: Fix @provides path for ZIP importer
